notes: Modified cash basis school district. Trimmed pages: p1 = report p22 (General Fund components with Depreciation Fund and reclassifications), p2-6 General Fund schedule, p7 Depreciation, p8 Special Building, p9 School Nutrition, p10 Bond, p11 Activities. No combined governmental statement is in the trimmed pages, so governmental receipts/disbursements are General+Depreciation Total column (p1, after reclassifications) plus the Special Building, Bond and Activities fund schedules; totals are computed sums. School Nutrition treated as business-type (cash). Transfers: General Fund out 45,000 = 30,000 to Nutrition (business-type transfers_net) + 15,000 to Activities (governmental in); the 150,000 General to Depreciation transfer is internal and eliminated on p1 (it sits inside the General Fund plant spending lines; detail shows a contra line and other financing line, review). Nonrevenue receipts 10,955 split into sale of property 969 and other 9,986 per p3. General Fund schedule p6 total disbursements 4,363,682 includes the 45,000 transfer line. Detail General Fund uses the schedule (pp2-6) only; p1 components statement not duplicated in detail. School budget columns that are group-level (federal programs 137,450; community service 27,777) left null/skipped because actual blank. Roll-forward governmental: 2,477,282 + 5,901,414 - 5,284,367 + 15,000 - 45,000 = 3,064,329. Business: 9,167 + 97,276 - 120,677 + 30,000 = 15,766. Balance sheet is a cash-basis summary of fund balances (no net position statement trimmed). Read pages 1-11 of 11
